topic: Pappu's result day, and Chacha Jee's 'true' story about his own report card.

episode.title: Pappu Ka Result Aur Chacha Ki Asli Report

shots.narration: چچا بولے، میری رپورٹ دیکھو گے تو حیران رہ جاؤ گے!
shots.scene: Bright Pakistani living room, warm sunshine, vertical 9:16, expressive 3D animated comedy film look, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha proudly raises a worn sealed envelope above his head beside an attentive Pappu.
shots.mood: Chacha's puffed chest and enormous confident grin.

shots.narration: پپو تو اپنا اچھا نتیجہ دکھانے آیا تھا۔
shots.scene: Sunny living room beside a low wooden table, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Pappu presents his report decorated only with shiny gold stars.
shots.mood: Pappu's modest smile beside Chacha's competitive raised eyebrow.

shots.narration: مگر چچا نے اپنی کامیابیوں کا قصہ چھیڑ دیا۔

shots.action: Chacha gestures grandly toward his own chest.
shots.mood: Exaggerated self-importance and Pappu's patient half-smile.

shots.narration: کہنے لگے، استاد بھی میری رپورٹ سنبھال کر رکھتے تھے!
shots.scene: Warm Pakistani living room, envelope centered on the low table, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha lovingly pats the sealed envelope.
shots.mood: Chacha's dreamy proud expression and Pappu's curious eyes.

shots.narration: پپو بولا، پھر آج ہمیں بھی دکھا دیں۔
shots.scene: Low wooden table in the sunlit living room, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Pappu slides the envelope toward Chacha.
shots.mood: Pappu's polite expectant smile and Chacha's suddenly stiff moustache.

shots.narration: چچا بولے، پرانی چیزیں کھولنے سے خراب ہوجاتی ہیں!
shots.scene: Living room table with the worn envelope, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chacha clamps both hands over the envelope.
shots.mood: Chacha's nervous grin and Pappu's gently skeptical raised eyebrow.

shots.narration: چاچی بولیں، لائیں، میں بہت احتیاط سے کھولتی ہوں۔
shots.scene: Bright living room around the low table, vertical 9:16, no visible text.
shots.action: Chachi pulls a folded report from the envelope beneath Chacha's hovering hands.
shots.mood: Chachi's knowing smile and Chacha's wide-eyed alarm.

shots.action: Chachi displays the red-covered report beside Pappu's gold-star report.
